name: backend-dev-guidelines
tagline_zh: 写 Express 路由时总纠结分层？这个 Skill 直接给出 routes→controllers→servi。
tagline_en: Tired of guessing Express layering? This skill maps routes→controllers→services→repositories with Prisma, Sentry.
desc_en: Comprehensive backend development guide for Node.js/Express/TypeScript microservices. Use when creating routes, controllers, services, repositories, middleware, or working with Express APIs, Prisma database access, Sentry error tracking, Zod validation, unifiedConfig, dependency injection, or async patterns. Covers layered architecture (routes → controllers → services → repositories), BaseControll
why_zh: 同类多讲概念，它直接给可复制的代码骨架，连依赖注入和异步模式都覆盖，省去翻文档的时间。
why_en: Unlike generic guides, it provides copy-paste code skeletons with DI and async patterns, saving hours of doc digging.
